description: This file defines a utility class ResponseAPI that provides static methods to generate different response objects, such as positive and negative responses, for a REST API.

classes.name: ResponseAPI
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to create various response objects for API responses.

methods.name: positiveResponse
methods.description: Creates a PositiveResponse object containing given data.

methods.name: emptyPositiveResponse
methods.description: Creates an empty PositiveResponse object with an empty list.

methods.name: negativeResponse
methods.description: Creates a NegativeResponse object with a status code, message, and result.
